## About
Prasad Raju G is an independent AI researcher focusing on ML/DL algorithms, Python, PyTorch, reproducing arXiv research papers, and building systems engineering projects on GitHub. His work sits at the intersection of applied mathematics, deep learning, and systems engineering.

## Skills
Python, C++, C, Applied Mathematics, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, System Design, Performance Engineering, Computer Vision.

## Interests
Artificial Intelligence, Game Theory, Quantum Physics, Neuroscience, Bioinformatics, Cryptography, Robotics, Quant Finance.
